words.tr: n. 房东（男性）；n. 房东（女性）
words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken door.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了坏掉的门。
words.en: A person who owns and rents out a building, especially a house or apartment.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 寄宿家庭；接待留学生的家庭
words.ex: I live with a host family in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我在加拿大和一个寄宿家庭住在一起。
words.en: A family that provides accommodation and meals for a student or traveler, often in exchange for payment or as part of a cultural exchange program.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.ex: The student adviser helped me choose my classes.
words.ex_cn: 学生顾问帮我选了课程。
words.en: A teacher or academic professional who provides guidance and support to students.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 租金价格；租赁价格
words.ex: The rental price of the apartment is $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租金是每月800美元。
words.en: The amount of money that is charged for the use of a property or item over a specified period of time.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 公用事业账单（如水、电、燃气等费用账单）
words.ex: He pays his utility bills every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付水电费。
words.en: Utility bills refer to the invoices received for essential services such as electricity, water, and gas, which are necessary for a household or business.

words.tr: phrase. 水费、燃气费、电费和电话费（合并账单）
words.ex: I pay my water gas electricity phone bill together every month.
words.ex_cn: 我每个月一起支付水费、燃气费、电费和电话费。

words.tr: adj. 可归还的；可退还的；
words.ex: The deposit is refundable if you return the item.
words.ex_cn: 如果你退回物品，押金是可以退还的。
words.en: If something is refundable, it means that the money you have paid for it can be returned to you under certain conditions.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: phrase. 为合同租赁支付费用；支付合同租赁款
words.ex: He must pay for the contract lease before moving in.
words.ex_cn: 他必须在搬入前支付合同租金。
words.en: To make regular payments for the use of property or equipment; to rent or hire under an agreement.

words.tr: phrase. 每周一次地；按周地
words.ex: He exercises on a weekly basis.
words.ex_cn: 他每周锻炼一次。
words.en: If something happens on a weekly basis, it happens once a week or every week.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: Many families live in the suburbs to have more space.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在郊区以获得更多的空间。
words.en: The suburbs are the residential areas on the outskirts of a city or large town.

words.ex: He lives in a rural area with few shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在几乎没有商店的乡村地区。
words.en: A rural area is an area of countryside, as opposed to a town or city.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的北风很冷。
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr:
n. 西北；
adj. 西北的；
words.ex: The storm is moving from the northwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴正从西北方向移动。
words.en: The northwest is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
n. 东北；
adj. 东北的；
words.ex: The storm came from the northeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东北方向。
words.en: The northeast is the direction which is halfway between north and east. It is also the area that lies in this direction.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr: phrase. 旅馆；招待所；宾客住所
words.ex: We stayed at a small guest house near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海滩附近的一家小招待所。
words.en: A guest house is a small, often family-run house offering accommodation to paying guests, typically in a tourist area.

words.ex: He lives in a small studio apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小单间公寓里。
words.en: A studio apartment is a small apartment which combines living room, bedroom, and kitchen into a single room.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.tr: phrase. 带两张单人床的双人房
words.ex: We booked a twin room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room with two single beds, typically for two people.

words.tr: phrase. 三人间（可供三人入住的房间）
words.ex: We booked a triple room for our family trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为家庭旅行预订了一个三人间。
words.en: A room that is designed to accommodate three people, typically equipped with three beds.

words.tr: phrase. 校内住宿；校园住宿
words.ex: Many universities offer on-campus accommodation for their students.
words.ex_cn: 许多大学为学生提供校内住宿。
words.en: Housing provided by an educational institution within its premises for students.

words.tr: phrase. 校外住宿；在校外租住的住房
words.ex: Many students prefer off-campus accommodation for its independence.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生更喜欢校外住宿，因为它的独立性。
words.en: Housing that is located away from the university or college campus, often preferred by students for reasons such as cost, privacy, or independence.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: adj. 带有私人浴室的；套房的
words.ex: The room has an en-suite bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一个内嵌浴室。
words.en: An adjective describing a room or facility that is directly connected to and for the private use of a bedroom, especially in a hotel or house.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍（供学生住宿的房屋或建筑群）
words.ex: The students live in the halls of residence near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在校园附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: Halls of residence are buildings where students live, typically provided by a university or college.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.tr: phrase. 特别的食物；特色食品
words.ex: He eats special food on his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日那天吃特别的食物。
words.en: Special food refers to food that is prepared or served for a particular occasion, purpose, or group of people, often characterized by its unique ingredients, preparation methods, or cultural significance.

words.tr: phrase. 食物过敏；对某些食物产生的异常免疫反应
words.ex: He avoids nuts because of food allergies.
words.ex_cn: 他因为食物过敏而避免吃坚果。
words.en: A food allergy is an abnormal immune response to food. The signs and symptoms may range from mild to severe. They may include itchiness, swelling of the tongue, vomiting, diarrhea, hives, trouble breathing, or low blood pressure.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.tr: phrase. 红色肉类（指羊肉、牛肉等）
words.ex: He eats red meat every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都吃红肉。
words.en: Red meat refers to meat that is red when raw and not white when cooked, such as beef, lamb, and pork. It is often contrasted with white meat, which refers to poultry and fish.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: They eat dinner in the kitchen-diner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都在厨房餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen-diner is a room that combines the functions of a kitchen and a dining area, allowing for cooking and eating in the same space.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: The fire gate closed automatically during the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 火灾警报时，防火门自动关闭了。
words.en: A fire gate is a barrier designed to prevent the spread of fire and smoke, often used in buildings and industrial settings to compartmentalize areas for safety.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the laundry room.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进洗衣房。
words.en: A room in a house or building where clothes and linens are washed and dried.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He turned on the air conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.ex: The store uses closed-circuit tv to watch customers.
words.ex_cn: 商店使用闭路电视来监控顾客。
words.en: A television system in which signals are transmitted over a closed circuit, such as within a building, for surveillance or security purposes.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.ex: He uses a vacuum cleaner to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用吸尘器打扫地板。
words.en: A vacuum cleaner is an electrical appliance that cleans floors and other surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.ex: The tour guide showed us the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古老的城堡。
words.en: A tour guide is a person who leads groups of people around a town, museum, or other tourist attraction, providing information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 导览；有导游带领的参观旅行
words.ex: They took guided tours of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a visit to a place of interest with a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: The children saw a big rainforest on their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了一片热带雨林。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall, typically located near the equator.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.ex: The cat hid behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫躲到了灌木丛后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant which is much smaller than a tree and has a lot of branches.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.ex: The hikers stopped at the viewing shelter to watch the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者在观测点停下来观看日落。
words.en: A viewing shelter is a structure designed to provide protection from the elements while allowing people to observe the surrounding scenery or wildlife.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 古老的寺庙；古代庙宇
words.ex: The ancient temple stands on a hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙坐落在一座山上。
words.en: An ancient temple refers to a very old building dedicated to religious or spiritual activities, often of historical significance.

words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.tr: phrase. 有机农场；采用有机耕作方式、不使用化肥和农药的农场
words.ex: He works on an organic farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个有机农场工作。
words.en: An organic farm is a farm that uses organic methods for growing crops and raising animals, avoiding the use of synthetic pesticides and fertilizers.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.tr: phrase. 海底世界；水下世界（指海洋深处的生态环境或幻想中的水下国度）
words.ex: He loves to watch undersea worlds on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看海底世界。
words.en: The term 'undersea worlds' refers to the vast and largely unexplored ecosystems beneath the ocean's surface, encompassing a wide range of marine life and geological formations.

words.ex: The children went to the amusement park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们星期天去了游乐园。
words.en: An amusement park is a large outdoor area with fairground rides, shows, and other entertainments.

words.ex: He walks in the orchard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在果园里散步。
words.en: An orchard is an area of land where fruit trees are grown.

words.ex: We walked on the beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform along the coast of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It usually consists of loose particles, which are often composed of rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.ex: They bathe in a hot spring every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在温泉里洗澡。
words.en: A hot spring is a natural spring of water whose temperature is higher than that of the surrounding area, often heated by geothermal activity.

words.ex: The old water mill turns slowly with the river flow.
words.ex_cn: 旧的水车随着河流缓慢转动。
words.en: A water mill is a mill that uses moving water as its power source; it is a structure that uses a water wheel or water turbine to drive a mechanical process such as milling (grinding), rolling, or hammering.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: The footbridge connects the two sides of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座人行桥连接了河的两岸。
words.en: A footbridge is a narrow bridge for pedestrians.

words.tr: phrase. 大堡礁（位于澳大利亚东北海岸外，是世界上最大的珊瑚礁系统）
words.ex: She swam near the great barrier reef last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，她在大堡礁附近游泳。
words.en: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, located off the coast of Queensland, Australia. It is composed of over 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands stretching for over 2,300 kilometers.

words.ex: Many tourists visit Stonehenge in England.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客参观英国的巨石阵。
words.en: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument in Wiltshire, England, consisting of a ring of standing stones, each around 13 feet high, seven feet wide, and weighing around 25 tons. It is one of the most famous landmarks in the United Kingdom and is regarded as a British cultural icon.

words.tr: 名词：悉尼歌剧院，位于澳大利亚悉尼港的标志性建筑，以其独特的帆形屋顶设计闻名，是世界著名的表演艺术中心
words.ex: We visited the Sydney Opera House last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天参观了悉尼歌剧院。
words.en: The Sydney Opera House is a multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney, Australia. It is one of the 20th century's most famous and distinctive buildings.

words.tr: phrase. 伦敦塔（英国伦敦一座历史悠久的城堡，曾用作皇宫、监狱和宝库）
words.ex: The tourists visited the Tower of London.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了伦敦塔。
words.en: The Tower of London is a historic castle on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. It was founded towards the end of 1066 as part of the Norman Conquest of England. The White Tower, which gives the entire castle its name, was built by William the Conqueror in 1078 and was a resented symbol of oppression, inflicted upon London by the new ruling elite.

words.ex: He plays a musical instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一件乐器。
words.en: A musical instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: He plays a string instrument called violin.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏一种叫做小提琴的弦乐器。
words.en: A string instrument is a musical instrument that produces sound by vibrating strings.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: He plays the cello as a cellist in the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他作为大提琴手在乐团里演奏大提琴。
words.en: A cellist is a musician who plays the cello.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.tr: n. 吉他弹奏者；吉他手
words.ex: He plays the guitar as a guitarist in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名吉他手在乐队里演奏。
words.en: A guitarist is a person who plays the guitar, especially as their job.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.ex: They went to the opera house last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去了歌剧院。
words.en: An opera house is a theatre building used for performances of opera.

words.ex: They went to karaoke bars to sing songs with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们去卡拉OK酒吧和朋友一起唱歌。
words.en: Karaoke bars are entertainment venues where people can sing along to recorded music using a microphone and an amplified audio system. The music typically has the lead vocals removed, allowing the singer to be the lead vocalist.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: They bushwalk in the national park every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末在国家公园里徒步穿越灌木丛。
words.en: A bushwalk is a walk through the bush, or countryside, especially in Australia, for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.tr: v. （尤指在山中）远足，徒步旅行，游山玩水；艰苦跋涉，徒步旅行( trek的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They went trekking in the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末去山里徒步旅行了。
words.en: Trekking is an activity that involves walking long distances, especially in the countryside or mountains.

words.tr: n. 露营； v. “camp”的现在分词；
words.ex: Camping in the mountains is fun.
words.ex_cn: 在山上露营很有趣。
words.en: Camping is the activity of staying in a tent on holiday.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松的聆听的；指音乐风格柔和、舒缓，适合背景播放的
words.ex: He likes easy listening music after work.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在下班后听轻松的音乐。
words.en: Music that is pleasant and not demanding to listen to, often characterized by soft melodies and smooth vocals.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: We enjoy live music at the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们喜欢在周末去公园听现场音乐。
words.en: Music that is performed in front of an audience, as opposed to music that is recorded and listened to at home.

words.tr: n. 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科舞厅；
words.ex: We went to a disco last Saturday night.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六晚上去了迪斯科舞会。
words.en: A disco is a club or party where people dance to pop music.

words.ex: He went to the pub after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.

words.ex: They meet at the clubhouse every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六在会所见面。
words.en: A clubhouse is a building used by members of a particular club, especially a sports club, for socializing, changing clothes, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 小剧场：一种较小规模的剧场，通常用于演出实验性、独立或小型剧目。
words.ex: The play was performed in a small studio theatre.
words.ex_cn: 这部戏剧在一间小型工作室剧场上演。
words.en: A small theater, often used for experimental or avant-garde performances.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: They attend theatrical events every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末都去看戏剧演出。
words.en: Performances or shows in a theater.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；大型零售商店，内部分为多个商品部门
words.ex: She buys clothes at department stores.
words.ex_cn: 她去百货商店买衣服。
words.en: A department store is a large shop which is divided into several departments, each selling a different type of goods.

words.ex: He loves rock climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末攀岩。
words.en: Rock climbing is the sport or activity of climbing steep rock surfaces, especially with the help of ropes and special equipment.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.ex: The shuttle bus takes us to the airport every hour.
words.ex_cn: 班车每小时接送我们去机场。
words.en: A shuttle bus is a bus that travels regularly between two places, especially a bus that takes people to and from an airport or between different parts of a city.

words.tr: n. 出租车（一种特定的出租车服务或类型）
words.ex: He called a cabtaxi to go to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他叫了一辆的士去机场。
words.en: A specific type or service of taxi.

words.tr: phrase. 四轮驱动者；指驾驶四轮驱动车辆的人
words.ex: He is a four-wheel driver who loves off-road adventures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名热爱越野冒险的四轮驱动者。
words.en: A vehicle equipped with a drivetrain that allows all four wheels to receive torque from the engine simultaneously, providing better traction and control on difficult terrain.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He drives a jeep to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他开吉普车去山区。
words.en: A jeep is a small, rugged vehicle designed for off-road use, often used by the military or for exploring remote areas.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: They took a river cruise down the Nile.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘船沿尼罗河游览。
words.en: A river cruise is a journey on a river, usually for pleasure, on a boat that is designed for carrying passengers.

words.ex: We went on boat trips every summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年夏天都去坐船旅行。
words.en: A journey or excursion made by boat.

words.tr: phrase. 体育俱乐部；运动社团
words.ex: He joins a sports club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个体育俱乐部。
words.en: A sports club is an organization where people can participate in various sports and physical activities.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: The players go to the locker room after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球员们去更衣室。
words.en: A locker room is a room, especially in a sports facility, where people can change their clothes and store their belongings in lockers.

words.ex: He goes to a keep-fit studio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身工作室。
words.en: A keep-fit studio is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical fitness.

words.tr: phrase. 舞蹈工作室；练舞房
words.ex: She goes to the dance studio every evening.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都去舞蹈工作室。
words.en: A dance studio is a space where dancers practice or train. It is often equipped with mirrors and a barre for ballet training.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.ex: He picked his dinner from the salad bar.
words.ex_cn: 他从沙拉吧挑选了他的晚餐。
words.en: A salad bar is a buffet-style table or counter at a restaurant or food service facility where customers can assemble their own salad plates from a variety of ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 室内体育场；室内体育馆
words.ex: The game will be held in an indoor stadium.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛将在室内体育馆举行。
words.en: An indoor stadium is a large building for sports events and concerts, designed to be used inside, away from the weather.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr: n. 饮食学家；营养学家；
words.ex: The dietician helped me plan healthy meals.
words.ex_cn: 饮食学家帮我规划了健康的饮食。
words.en: A dietician is a professional who is qualified to give advice about diet and nutrition.

words.tr: phrase. 内部成员；内部构件；内部成员函数（编程中指类或结构体内部定义的成员）
words.ex: He is an internal member of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队的内部成员。
words.en: A person who is part of an organization or group from within.

words.tr: phrase. 外部成员；指不属于某个组织或团体内部，但参与其工作的成员
words.ex: He is an external member of the committee.
words.ex_cn: 他是委员会的外部成员。
words.en: A person who is part of a group but not a permanent member.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.ex: He took a passport photo at the studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在照相馆拍了一张护照照片。
words.en: A photograph that is required for official documents such as passports.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证明文件；用于证明身份的材料
words.ex: He showed his documents for id at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证明文件。
words.en: Official papers used to verify a person's identity.

words.ex: He got his driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: An official document permitting a person to drive a motor vehicle.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: phrase. 公用事业账单（如水、电、燃气等费用账单）
words.ex: He pays his utility bills every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付水电费。
words.en: Utility bills refer to the invoices received for essential services such as electricity, water, and gas, which are necessary for a household or business.

words.tr: phrase. 雇主出具的推荐信；由雇主提供的证明信
words.ex: He sent a reference letter from his employer to the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他把雇主写的推荐信寄给了新公司。
words.en: A document written by an employer that provides a testimonial of an employee's skills, achievements, and work ethic, often used in job applications.

words.tr: phrase. 入会费；加入时需缴纳的费用
words.ex: You must pay a joining fee to use the gym.
words.ex_cn: 你要支付一笔入会费才能使用健身房。
words.en: A joining fee is a sum of money that you pay when you become a member of a club or organization.

words.ex: The gym charges an annual fee of $50.
words.ex_cn: 健身房收取50美元的年费。
words.en: A yearly charge for the use of a service or membership.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr: phrase. 沙滩排球（一种在沙滩上进行的排球运动）
words.ex: They play beach volleyball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末打沙滩排球。
words.en: A sport played on sand by two teams of two players who try to hit a ball over a net without letting it touch the ground on their side of the court.

words.ex: He plays basketball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打篮球。
words.en: A game played between two teams of five players in which goals are scored by throwing a ball through a netted hoop fixed above each end of the court.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: He plays handball after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后打手球。
words.en: Handball is a team sport in which two teams of seven players each pass a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午打乒乓球。
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: He made a gear change while driving uphill.
words.ex_cn: 他在上坡时换了一挡。
words.en: The act of changing from one gear to another in a vehicle.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 最高速度；最大速率
words.ex: The car reached its top speed on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上达到了最高速度。
words.en: The highest speed that a vehicle, aircraft, or other object can reach.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 仪表板；仪表盘；控制面板
words.ex: The pilot checks the instrument panel before takeoff.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前检查仪表盘。
words.en: An instrument panel is a board in a vehicle or machine that contains instruments and controls.

words.ex: He used his old car in a part exchange for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的旧车以旧换新换了一辆新车。
words.en: A transaction in which a used item is given as partial payment for a new one.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.ex: He loves boxing and trains every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢拳击运动，每天训练。
words.en: Boxing is a sport in which two people fight each other using their fists, usually while wearing padded gloves.

words.ex: He practices kick-boxing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习跆拳道。
words.en: A combat sport involving kicking and punching, performed while standing and with the use of protective gear.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.tr: n. 慢跑； v. “jog”的现在分词；
words.ex: He goes jogging every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去慢跑。
words.en: Jogging is the activity of running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: She does aerobics every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上做有氧运动来保持健康。
words.en: Aerobics is a form of physical exercise that combines rhythmic aerobic exercise with stretching and strength training routines with the goal of improving all elements of fitness (flexibility, muscular strength, and cardio-vascular fitness).

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.tr: phrase. 发动机排量；引擎大小
words.ex: The car has a large engine size.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的发动机排量很大。
words.en: The volume of space in the cylinders of an internal combustion engine that is swept by the pistons.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.ex: He turned the steering wheel to the left.
words.ex_cn: 他把方向盘向左转。
words.en: A steering wheel is a wheel that the driver of a vehicle turns in order to steer the vehicle.

words.ex: The car bumper is broken after the crash.
words.ex_cn: 车祸后，汽车保险杠坏了。
words.en: A car bumper is a bar at the front and back of a vehicle that is designed to reduce damage in a collision.

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: He went overdrawn on his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他的银行账户透支了。
words.en: An overdraft occurs when money is withdrawn from a bank account and the available balance goes below zero.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 两人共有的银行账户；联合账户
words.ex: They have a joint account for their rent and groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个共同账户用于支付房租和杂货。
words.en: A joint account is a bank account shared by two or more individuals, typically used for managing shared expenses or assets.

words.tr: phrase. 即时账户；可立即开通并使用的账户
words.ex: He opened an instant account online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线上开设了一个即时账户。
words.en: An instant account is a type of bank account that can be opened quickly, often online, and allows for immediate use without the need for a lengthy application process.

words.tr: phrase. 选择账户；挑选账号
words.ex: You must select account before you can log in.
words.ex_cn: 你必须选择账户才能登录。
words.en: Choose a specific account from available options.

words.tr: phrase. 起始金额；启动资金；首笔款项
words.ex: The opening sum is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 起始金额是五美元。
words.en: The initial amount of money required or available at the start of a project, investment, or account.

words.tr: phrase. 身份安全；对数字身份及其相关敏感信息的保护，防止未经授权的访问、盗用或泄露
words.ex: He uses a password for identity security.
words.ex_cn: 他使用密码来保障身份安全。
words.en: Identity security refers to the measures and technologies used to protect individuals' identities from theft or fraud, especially in digital environments.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.ex: He exchanged dollars for foreign currency.
words.ex_cn: 他把美元换成了外币。
words.en: Foreign currency refers to the money of another country that is used in financial transactions.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: He paid five euros for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五欧元买咖啡。
words.en: The euro is the official currency of the Eurozone, which consists of 19 of the 27 member states of the European Union.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: He is an associate professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的副教授。
words.en: An associate professor is a mid-level academic rank in universities and colleges, above assistant professor and below full professor.

words.ex: He is the convener of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他是这次会议的召集人。
words.en: A convener is someone who arranges meetings or conferences and is responsible for ensuring that they run smoothly.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr: phrase. 低年级学生；大三学生；初中生
words.ex: The junior student is learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这名低年级学生每天都在学英语。
words.en: A junior student is a student in the lower grades of a school or college.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: The student adviser helped me choose my classes.
words.ex_cn: 学生顾问帮我选了课程。
words.en: A teacher or academic professional who provides guidance and support to students.

words.tr: phrase. 课程负责人；课程召集人（负责组织和管理某门课程的教职人员）
words.ex: The course convener sends the schedule to students.
words.ex_cn: 课程负责人把课程表发给学生。
words.en: A person responsible for organizing and overseeing the academic content and administration of a specific course or module within an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 高年级学生；（尤指大学或中学的）四年级学生
words.ex: The senior student helps new students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 高年级学生帮助新生做作业。
words.en: A senior student is a student in the final year of high school or college.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: He is a postgraduate student in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名生物学的研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate student is someone who is studying for a degree that is higher than the one they received as an undergraduate, typically a master's degree or a PhD.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He joined a diploma course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个计算机科学的文凭课程。
words.en: A diploma course is a program of study that leads to a diploma, typically offered by educational institutions as a shorter or more specialized alternative to degree programs.

words.ex: New students join orientation week to learn about the school.
words.ex_cn: 新生参加迎新周以了解学校。
words.en: A week at the beginning of a university term, during which a series of events are organized to introduce new students to the university and to help them settle in.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He joins extracurricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Extracurricular activities are those that fall outside the realm of the normal curriculum of school or university education, performed by students. Extracurricular activities exist at all levels of education, from 4th-6th, junior high/high school, college and university education.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影的选修课。
words.en: An optional course is a class that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but it is not required for their degree.

words.ex: He is taking a specialized course in robotics.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修一门机器人方面的专业课程。
words.en: A course designed to provide in-depth knowledge or training in a specific area of study or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 一般课程；通识课程
words.ex: He is taking a general course in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中上一门通识课程。
words.en: A broad, introductory educational program or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 核心项目；核心课程；主要计划
words.ex: The core programme of the organization focuses on education and community development.
words.ex_cn: 该组织的核心计划专注于教育和社区发展。
words.en: The central or most important part of a plan or program.

words.tr: phrase. 全日制课程；指需要全天或大部分时间投入的学习课程
words.ex: He is taking a full-time course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一门全日制计算机科学课程。
words.en: A full-time course is an educational program that requires students to attend classes or engage in educational activities for a significant portion of the day, typically equivalent to a standard working day, as opposed to part-time courses which require less time commitment.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr: phrase. 社会科学；社会科学学科
words.ex: He studies social science at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习社会科学。
words.en: Social science is the study of society and the relationships among individuals within a society.

words.ex: The map shows the topography of the mountain area.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山区的地形。
words.en: The topography of an area is the physical features of its surface, such as hills, valleys, and rivers, especially the representation of these features on maps.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 模块化课程；由若干独立单元组成的课程
words.ex: He takes a modular course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他修了一门模块化的计算机科学课程。
words.en: A modular course is a course of study that is divided into separate units or modules, each of which can be studied independently.

words.tr: phrase. 训练课程；培训时段
words.ex: The team had a training session at 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 团队在早上六点进行了一次训练。
words.en: A training session is a period of time during which people are taught how to do something or how to improve their skills in a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 进修课程；复习课程
words.ex: He took a refresher course in math before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前参加了一个数学复习课程。
words.en: A refresher course is a training course that helps people review and update their knowledge or skills in a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 强化课程；集中培训班
words.ex: He took an intensive course to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个密集课程来快速学习英语。
words.en: An intensive course is a course of study that covers a lot of material in a short period of time, requiring a high level of effort and concentration from the students.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the course outline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程大纲。
words.en: A course outline is a document that summarizes the main points of a course, including the objectives, content, and assessment methods.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: phrase. 非全日制课程；兼职课程
words.ex: He is taking a part-time course on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末在上一门兼职课程。
words.en: A part-time course is an educational program that allows students to study while also working or engaging in other activities, typically requiring fewer hours of attendance than a full-time course.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.ex: He is taking an advanced course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门高级数学课程。
words.en: A course designed for students who already have a good understanding of the basic concepts and are ready to tackle more complex or specialized topics.

words.ex: He attends a night class to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他上夜校学习英语。
words.en: A class that is held in the evening, typically for adults who are working during the day.

words.tr: phrase. 周末课程；在周末开设的课程
words.ex: She attends a weekend class to learn new skills.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了一个周末班来学习新技能。
words.en: A class that is held on the weekend, typically for educational purposes.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He is learning biophysics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物物理学。
words.en: Biophysics is the science of the application of the laws of physics to biological phenomena.

words.ex: He loves cartography and draws maps for fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢制图，闲暇时画地图。
words.en: Cartography is the science or practice of drawing maps.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr: phrase. 高级英语研究；指在高等教育或专业领域中对英语语言、文学及文化的深入学习与研究
words.ex: He is doing advanced english studies at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习高级英语课程。
words.en: Advanced English studies refer to higher-level courses or programs focused on the in-depth learning and understanding of the English language, its literature, and its use in various contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 通用英语；普通英语（指非专业性、基础性的英语）
words.ex: He is learning general English to talk with tourists.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习通用英语以便与游客交流。
words.en: The everyday language used in casual conversation and general communication.

words.tr: phrase. 学术英语，指用于学术环境中的正式英语，常用于教育、研究和学术出版物中
